In the near future you will find here more versions of the kernel, both with and without integrated ramdisk.</p>
<p>
<span class="subtitle">Kernels For Cassiopeia BE300</span>
<br>
Kernel 2.4.18 with serial debug and framebuffer support: <a href="/download/kernel/vmlinux">vmlinux</a> Use the <a href="bootloader.php">bootloader</a> to get it started.
<p>
<span class="subtitle">Patches for the BE300 kernel</span>
<br>
If you did not yet get a clean version of the sources, make sure to get a stable starting point <a href="clean.php">by clicking here</a> 
<br>
You can get the latest specific BE300 files from the Linux4BE CVS server:
<br>Login into CVS tree.
<br>cvs -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux4.be:/cvsroot login
<br>
<br>Press "Return" when prompted for password. You only need to do this once on any machine.
<br>Check out a copy of the tree.
<br>cvs -z3 -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux4.be:/cvsroot co linux/kernel
<br>
<br>Now copy those files over your existing sourcetree, and you're ready to build:
<br>make mrproper ; cp config_be300 .config ; make oldconfig dep clean ; make

<p>(<a href="clean.php">click here</a> for instructions on getting a 'clean' sourcetree.)
<p><span class="subtitle">Kernels For Cassiopeia E100</span>
<br>
<a href="/download/kernel/vmlinux_e100_nofb_2_4_18.gz">Linux version 2.4.18-mips (gzipped, size 782.686 bytes)</a> Version that uses CF root-disk, no framebuffer support (needs serial cable to connect)
